artifact: PHASE 4C §8, §9, §37 - a builder or grower is an expression subtree, never a formula type
classificationIsByShape: a literal operand is base; a percentage multiplied by a fact grows with it; any other operand needing a fact builds from it. No metric name is read.

matrix.case: A. a flat amount plus half of one metric
B. a different flat amount plus a quarter of a different metric
C. the greater of a flat amount and a tenth of a metric
D. an opening amount plus an accumulating metric
E. the same shape as A with every name and number changed
F. the lesser of a flat amount and a grower
G. two metrics in one capacity
